theory.title: Obligación, prohibición y consejos en contextos culturales
theory.explanation: Usa must y have to para expresar una obligación; mustn't para prohibir; don't have to para indicar que algo no es necesario; y should u ought to para dar consejos. Elige el modal según el significado que quieres comunicar.
theory.tip: Mustn't prohíbe; don't have to indica que no es necesario; should aconseja.

content.passage: The visitor centre explains how to travel responsibly. Visitors must respect local customs and mustn't leave rubbish in protected areas. They have to follow the safety instructions on guided walks. People don't have to speak the local language perfectly, but they should learn a few polite expressions. The centre also says travellers ought to support local businesses and ask before taking photographs of people.

items.prompt: Explain what visitors must do in a cultural centre.
items.modelAnswer: I believe learning about other cultures helps people become more open-minded. When I visit a new place, I try to respect local customs and learn a few useful expressions. At first, some differences may feel unfamiliar, but people can understand one another if they communicate politely. I enjoy meeting local people because we can share experiences and learn from each other. In the future, I hope to take part in more international exchanges.

content.audioTranscript: A: How was the cultural exchange? B: Great. The students stayed with a local host family. A: Did they learn about local traditions? B: Yes, and they practised the language every day. A: Did they attend the town festival? B: They did. The whole community was involved. A: How did the visitors behave? B: They showed respect and made new friendships.
